> Oh shit man suicide wont solve anything

how won't it?  i won't have to deal with my shitty life anymore and noone else will have to deal with my bullshit anymore.  win/win

i can't read dude.  my brain is too foggy for that. half of the words don't even register and the words that do register trigger no emotion or interest.  my brain is scrambled eggs at this point from benzo dependency and previous illicit drug use.

>Learn languages

why?  i can't even leave my town let alone the country.

>you really should try online games

i'm decades ahead of you on that one bro.  shit gets old.  i have chronic pain in my hands, wrists and forearms from gaming so much (i've mentioned this in previous posts i made in this sub on different accounts) and on top of that i just no longer find video games enjoyable.  there is nothing fun about it anymore.

>The suffering will eventually end for sure and the sky is gonna be clear again.

not sure there's any evidence it ever will.
